stem: (Select TWO.) An engineer at Foundry Metals runs `terraform apply -destroy` from a directory with no other flags supplied, to tear down a small test environment. Which two statements are accurate?

choices.text: On the version of Terraform in use here, `-destroy` can only be used to preview a plan, never to actually carry one out
This creates a plan to destroy every remote object the configuration manages, then carries it out like an ordinary apply
`-destroy` skips the interactive confirmation prompt on its own, with no other flag involved
apply -destroy does nothing at all unless a specific resource address is separately supplied on the command line
With no `-auto-approve` supplied, Terraform still prompts for confirmation before performing the destroy

rationale: apply -destroy builds a plan to destroy every object the configuration manages and then executes it the way any apply does, and without -auto-approve the interactive prompt still applies before anything is destroyed. Current Terraform accepts -destroy on apply as well as plan, so it is not preview-only on this version. Skipping the prompt requires -auto-approve; -destroy by itself does not remove that step. -destroy with no other flag still targets every managed object, not nothing.
